sources: SSC (ssc.gov.in) notices and the process followed in recent cycles

admitCard.where: Your SSC candidate account on ssc.gov.in and the SSC regional website for your region
admitCard.when: Exam city slip a few days before the exam, admit card about 2 to 4 days before your own shift
steps: Open the SSC website (ssc.gov.in) and sign in to your candidate account with your registration number and password, or open the admit card link of your region.
Check the exam city and date slip first. SSC releases it a few days before the admit card.
Download the admit card when it is published, usually a few days before your own exam date, and print it clearly.
Check name, photo, roll number, shift, reporting time and centre address against your application. If something is wrong, write to your regional office at once, before exam day.
carry: The original photo ID named in the admit card instructions
Only what the admit card allows. Phones, watches and calculators are normally not allowed inside
admitCard.note: **SSC GD 2026 final keys, question papers with responses and CBE marks have been released under the 3 November notice.** Access runs from **3 November, 17:00 to 17 November, 17:00**. Use Roll Number/Password for the notice’s final-key link and Registered ID/Password on SSC for marks. Save both records before the deadline. The 12 October PET/PST shortlist and 23 October category clarification remain separate selection instructions; follow the authorised physical-stage notice and call letter.

answerKey.summary: The 3 November SSC notice releases GD 2026 final answer keys and question papers with responses. The same notice makes CBE marks available. The access period is 3 November at 17:00 to 17 November at 17:00; save both your response document and scorecard.
steps: Read the 3 November notice and open its final-key candidate link using Roll Number and Password.
Use Registered ID and Password on ssc.gov.in for your CBE marks.
Save or print your own final-key/response document and scorecard before the stated 17 November, 17:00 deadline.
answerKey.fee: This is a final-key and marks release. The 3 November notice does not announce a new paid objection window.
answerKey.note: Compare the correct question IDs and retain the official marks record. A raw-score reconstruction does not replace the normalised result or the published selection list.

Race, height, chest and other standards, held by the forces at their centres. Qualifying only.

result.scorecard: CBE marks are available on SSC using Registered ID and Password during the 3 November, 17:00 to 17 November, 17:00 period specified in the notice. Save a copy before access ends.
